# simplemdm_device_custom_attribute_values (Resource)

Sets multiple custom attribute values on a single device in one PUT call. This is a fire-and-apply resource: changes to `assignments` apply on Update; the resource has no per-attribute drift detection. Use `triggers` to force a re-apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "simplemdm_device_custom_attribute_values" "alice_phone" {
  device_id = "1234"

  assignments {
    name  = "department"
    value = "platform-team"
  }

  assignments {
    name  = "office"
    value = "berlin"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String) Required. Device ID.

### Optional

- `assignments` (Block List) List of (attribute name, value) pairs to apply. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--assignments))
- `triggers` (Map of String) Optional arbitrary string map. Changing any value forces resource replacement, re-applying the bulk update.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Synthetic identifier (`device_cav:<device_id>`).
- `last_applied` (String)

<a id="nestedblock--assignments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `assignments`

Required:

- `name` (String) Custom attribute name (must already exist).
- `value` (String) Value to set for the attribute on this device.
